en.title: The grammar categories at a glance
en.summary: Number, gender, case, person, tense, mood, voice and aspect, and where English shows them.

paragraphs: Grammar categories describe the changes a word can have: number, gender, case, person, tense, mood, voice and aspect.
English marks few of these on nouns. Nouns change for number and the possessive. Pronouns change for case and gender. Verbs change for tense, person, mood, voice and aspect.
